news: The kit sets up a club hall, a treasury and a quest board in under a minute.
The snow world ships with ski rides, a lodge venue and twelve looks to start.
A repo that became a city
Two builders shared a street layout repo. Forty clubs forked it and joined their streets into one district.
Apps now update in the background and switch over the next time you open them.
Book rides between worlds with a single install. Pricing comes from the ride owner.
Every app now has a trail
See who published each version, what changed and who reviewed it.
An update to Brocade adds a market that opens after dark with its own stalls.
A quiz app made for one club now runs in 600 halls across Phiace.
Clubs can now keep repos for members only and publish them later.
Thirty new quest templates, from scavenger hunts to style battles.
If an update breaks your hall, roll back to the last version from Installed.
Ferries now dock in Aurum, linking it to five other worlds.

faq.a: A rotating panel of members and the Phihub team checks every new version.

faq.q: Can I publish my own app?
faq.a: Yes. Connect a repo, fill in the listing and submit it for review.
Most are. Paid apps show the price in SUM before you install.
Open Installed and choose Remove. Your data stays until you delete it.
Installed worlds load from your machine and sync when you are back online.
